content: Memory curation follows a 5-stage automated pipeline: 采集 (collect from session_search/letta/memory-engine), 炼化 (LLM-based grading/compression/deduplication), 写入 (update MEMORY.md with character limit enforcement), 同步 (optional letta memory blocks sync), 报告 (output curation report). This is a reusable workflow pattern for automated memory extraction.
